categories.name: Bridged WBNB
categories.content: Bridged WBNB refers to Wrapped BNB that has been transferred from its native blockchain to a different blockchain through "bridging".

categories.name: aarna Vault Tokens
categories.content: aarna Vault Tokens are vault-specific ERC-20 tokens representing shares in aarnâ's tokenized vaults. Users deposit stablecoins like USDC/USDT into AI-managed or yield-optimizing vaults and receive these tokens in return, which track the vault's net asset value (NAV).

categories.name: Yield Tokenization Product
categories.content: Yield tokenization product refers to converting the expected future yield or returns from an asset into tradable tokens on a blockchain, allowing for the trading, management, and optimization of yield independently from the underlying asset.

categories.name: ERC20i
categories.content: ERC20i is a token standard on Base blockchain that extends the capabilities of ERC-20 tokens by adding native inscriptions.

categories.name: Yoink.fun Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Yoink (https://yoinkai.fun/), an agentic launch and trading terminal on Robinhood Chain.

categories.name: TRY Stablecoin
categories.content: A TRY stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Turkish lira.

categories.name: Layer 2 (L2)
categories.content: Layer 2s are off-chain vertical scaling solutions that run on top of Layer 1 blockchains like Ethereum to improve scalability, while maintaining the decentralization and security standards of the Layer 1.

categories.name: Tokenized Money Market Fund (MMFs)
categories.content: Tokens that represent shares or units (1:1) of a regulated money market fund, issued or recorded on-chain by a regulated entity. The token is yield-bearing, passing through the fund's NAV and returns via accumulating or distributing share classes.

categories.name: Flaunch Ecosystem
categories.content: Flaunch Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via flaunch.gg.

categories.name: SideChain
categories.content: A sidechain is a separate blockchain that runs parallel to a main blockchain. It allows transactions and applications to operate independently to enhance scalability and functionality.

categories.name: bStocks Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized representations of U.S.-listed stocks and ETFs issued by BTech Holdings Limited, a Binance Group affiliate structured as a Special Purpose Vehicle in the Abu Dhabi Global Market.

categories.name: AUD Stablecoin
categories.content: A AUD stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Australian Dollar (AUD).

categories.name: Camelot Launchpad
categories.content: Camelot Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed
categories.content: The Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed category features community-driven assets representing specific agent personas or viral narratives (memes) within the Moltbook platform.

categories.name: Trading Card RWA Platform
categories.content: Trading Card RWA Platforms tokenize physical collectible cards (e.g., Pokémon, sports cards) on a blockchain. The physical cards are stored with a custodian or vault, and each blockchain token represents ownership of the real-world card. This enables features such as fractional ownership and global secondary trading.

categories.name: Tourism
categories.content: A coin or token that leverages blockchain technology to improve various aspects of the tourism industry.

categories.name: Tokenized Assets
categories.content: Tokenized products refers to digital representation of assets on a blockchain platform.

categories.name: Tokenized Silver
categories.content: Tokenized silver refers to digital representation of physical silver on a blockchain platform.

categories.name: Trading Bots
categories.content: Trading bots are automated software programs that execute cryptocurrency trades based on predefined rules or algorithms. They analyze market data like price, volume, and order book activity to make buy or sell decisions without human intervention.

categories.name: Capital Launchpad (Kaito)
categories.content: Capital Launchpad is a Web3 crowdfunding platform by Kaito that connects early-stage crypto projects with investors through a merit-based allocation system.
